Pull workflow files from inst/workflow for each package

Source: R/utils-workflows.R
pull_workflows.Rd

For each resolved package, pulls files from inst/workflow. If that directory is missing but inst/workflows exists, a warning asks maintainers to rename to the preferred convention and re-run snapshot(). Pulled files are merged directly into a workflows/ subdirectory under path. Destination filename collisions across repositories emit a warning and the most recently pulled file wins.

Usage

pull_workflows(resolved, path)

Arguments

resolved

List of resolved package metadata (each with org, repo, sha).

path

Character. Output directory.
